page_title: MAR 2-2 MON | Marseille v Monaco 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Vitinha (Marseille) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Wissam Ben Yedder is replaced by Chrislain Matsima (Monaco).
88' The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
86' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) sees a yellow card in the hand of Willy Delajod. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is sent from the pitch.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sofiane Sidi Ali (Marseille) replaces Jean Onana.
86' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) replacing Maghnes Akliouche.
85' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Joaquin Correa (Marseille), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post.
82' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Joaquin Correa (Marseille) for Emran Soglo.
76' Emran Soglo (Marseille) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
76' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
75' A player from Marseille brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
74' Flag goes up against Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
69' Vitinha (Marseille) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
68' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

68' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Philipp Kohn stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner. Marseille win a corner.
66' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
64' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
61' A player from Marseille commits a rough challenge. Willy Delajod blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
56' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul.
54' Vitinha (Marseille) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
53' Good work from Marseille as they win a corner.
51' Marseille take a short corner kick.

50' 2 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Philipp Kohn just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:2.
48' An attempted cross from Luis Henrique (Marseille) is cleared.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 1 - 2 Goal! Wissam Ben Yedder tees up Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

43' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Philipp Kohn stops the ball from going inside the left post. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.

38' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Willy Delajod signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Marseille players celebrate. Goal! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home. He has every right to celebrate.
38' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
38' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Willy Delajod wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
35' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is substituted due to injury. Gennaro Gattuso gives a chance to Emran Soglo.
34' The game is interrupted now, Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Marseille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
32' The free kick from long range, taken by Marseille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
24' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
21' A sweet pass inside the box gives Vitinha (Marseille) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
20' A player from Monaco commits a rough challenge. Willy Delajod blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
18' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Now Monaco have a corner.
17' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' Willy Delajod interrupts the game. One of the players from Marseille won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
13' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Marseille was in an offside position.
11' Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!

7' 0 - 1 0:1. Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is! Pau Lopez did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Aleksandr Golovin provided the assistance.
5' The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
4' Marseille force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
3' Willy Delajod has a clear sight and sees a foul from Guillermo Maripan (Monaco).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod was nominated as the referee for this game.
